title: Independently recheck WP1 0119 F3 corrections and F4 blocked disposition
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Independently adjudicate the semantic adequacy of the wp1-key-0119 F3 corrections and F4 blocked disposition against unchanged authoritative sources, with explicit continuity to review #574. Expected gain: a pinned per-finding/per-affected-ID verdict in .session/artifacts/wp1-disposition-review-0120.json and a concise Standards/Spec report, so the next shaper can distinguish an adequately contained proposal from a usable complete key. This is a separate semantic recheck, not a new cold derivation or a complete benchmark readiness review. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no native behavior, validity or save-version preservation.
## Acceptance
- [ ] FIRST establish observed HEAD/tree and compare the scoped package/source bytes with Context pins and the intended checkout. Record actual and intended identities plus any scoped differences before adjudication; fail closed on a material mismatch. Review outputs are confined to .session/report.md and .session/artifacts/, with no repository edits. This exposed review is never labeled cold; #574's cold expectation remains historical session-specific evidence.
- [ ] Read the actual preserved review findings /findings/0 and /findings/1, the pre-edit dispositions and cited authoritative method/protocol/README leaves. Independently assess every F3 changed source-to-rule mapping against its operative meaning, including whether required rules are missing, irrelevant or overstated. Record exact locators, old/new links, reasoning and agree/disagree/uncertain verdicts. Check source/predecessor continuity and untouched mappings with bounded comparisons; do not rerun completed F1/F2 semantic probes or cold derivation solely for continuity. A new defect gets its own finding rather than silent scope expansion.
- [ ] Independently assess F4 using actual preserved raw answers, unchanged complete-map requirements, separate correctness/grounding tests, example ledgers, whole-answer aggregation and explicit evidence reservations. Decide whether blocking established-key use and both affected example map slots faithfully contains the missing evidence, and whether the proposed partial/unverified assessments follow the cited rules. Verify that no unseen sidecar, invented inventory, weakened requirement or implicit complete positive control is credited. Distinguish disposition adequacy from F4 clearance: missing preservation evidence and incomplete-key usability remain explicit even if the blocked disposition is adequate.
- [ ] Inspect the new checker and run the Verification command once; record its identity, command, exit/output and what its focused controls can and cannot establish. Do not execute preserved wp1-review-audit-0118.py, historical checkers, old probes or agent/native arms. Verify saved verification/file pins with bounded queries. Integrity/control success supplies no independent semantic verdict.
- [ ] Save a structured review artifact with intended/observed commit/tree, scoped hashes, source locators, per-mapping and per-affected-ID adjudications, unchanged-continuity evidence, checker observations, findings/severity, Standards and Spec verdicts, exact reviewed scope and remaining uncertainty. Report Standards and Spec separately in .session/report.md, naming any blocking findings and the smallest next step. Do not demand a committed reviewer output: this role has no repository write paths. Preserve C1 and all native, inventory, isolation/allocation, independent-method-review, owner-acceptance and readiness gaps; no proposal/index promotion or product approval.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0119.py
## Context
Iteration 0119 record .session/history/records/0119.json reports #577 done, accepted and merged, commit f4528e8. Trusted report .session/reports/577.json snapshot 23ba3ba7e812b65fe039ee83c7ca4606535a778ad6d8b3880370fc2272a1c36a and the linked benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.md describe new mappings and an explicitly blocked F4 alternative, not independent clearance. Intended review checkout: 8b7cc7bedd1177a06e03ceb2c42e5030081de96f from this shaper's history manifest; record its tree using git and actual reviewer HEAD/tree. Administrative commits may differ: disclose the difference and establish scoped-byte equality rather than silently claiming an exact commit match. SHA256 pins: wp1-key-0119.json 2afdca4bfc6feaa9464348bed7709b0657ea1ccbbe5d6b0a33b549c78f41c142; wp1-key-0119.md 5f18384ed27e6b995426704f40316e69ee09a52084767304c15738f6e78980ac; check_wp1_key_0119.py 28ee70435c6a4fea7a79d942e7d90e9e3174ec31d64d741f93447000bc093d99; wp1-key-0119-verification.json bd6054c90b5264bb9e7909937dfabae39bd919665f869a8424d1346aaa5e6cfd. Preserved wp1-key-review-0118.json 410b0ebf7d3135521d10bd32d3b1102769caa848f5e5c7278d8e9a29eefd9a55; cold expectation 7ca817b22c430ece354287b0e42cd3deb106afaeee9a0d3d6c9d7dfd4dad141c; source interpretation b18eb04d01455a3d4b539a67042a83c4efc5d627f73ccd309ba6f1e7f48ea46b; audit script 8fc53c741b4d6628228e0abae53fbf3c64200c3f318d6ac903c8bbf73b13e833. All are now repository files under benchmark/writing/, not staged historical inputs. Source method.json 276f2881c70eae311195a4cc0a802e316ca06a206a0f1d16e7f041205fd3b0ac; protocol.md 1aeb83227dc11761160ff80d24eb03a216a2531d90c1a6d10ccb25bb85c7eb2f. Read actual source inventories before asserting counts; shaper has not independently measured package counts or semantics.
## Budget
Read benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.md, wp1-key-0119-pre-edit-findings.md and review-0118-provenance.md; query wp1-key-0119.json, wp1-key-0119-verification.json and wp1-key-review-0118.json for actual findings/dispositions, pins, mappings, raw-answer references, affected example ledgers and reservations, without dumping whole large JSON. Read check_wp1_key_0119.py; hash preserved wp1-review-audit-0118.py without executing it. Consult wp1-cold-expectation-0118.json and wp1-source-interpretation-0118.json as historical independent evidence, never as this session's blind derivation. Compare relevant sections of wp1-key-0117.json and its pinned package; older 0115/0116 material only for a concrete continuity discrepancy. Read source method.json cited common leaves and tasks/4 requirements, benchmark/protocol.md cited answer/grading/preservation clauses, benchmark/writing/README.md relevant scope, docs/perpetua/evaluation.md readiness contract, and original.lvproj/LICENSE.txt in benchmark/real-project-0107/ only for pins/locators. No global gap-map review, new fixture package, original/source regeneration, historical builders or readiness-index changes. Keep command outputs short and report pin failures early. Engine verification cannot read .session/artifacts or report; the command checks the repository package only, while the semantic verdict lives in reviewer outputs. No git commit, shell expansion, pipes or redirection.
